source: Follow-up read-only source review by the same independent gpt-6.1-terra subagent
candidate_scope: The current set consists of opportunities produced by the frozen controller, not an enumeration or official legality mask of all game actions. The model cannot select tasks outside that set.
missing_join: The completion pipeline discards callback inputs after validation and does not currently join each episode origin to its decision-time features. A separately verified one-to-one join must match game, first step, first ordinal, chosen identity and candidate semantics; duplicates or missing matches must stop the experiment.
target_correction: The existing task_dagger_once_v1 data path trains on teacher_label. This probe must instead use the episode's actual first chosen candidate as the supervised target when conditioning on that episode's observed effect; teacher_label cannot substitute for chosen.
feature_boundary: Inputs must be captured from the first decision only and may contain only decision-time actor-visible information and prior same-turn controller planning state. The future completion status can select or stratify data but must never enter model features.
existing_components: The shared/candidate encoder and ragged training skeleton are reusable. Existing split assumptions and training parameters are tied to a different preregistered study and must not be silently changed or reused as if they described this study.
evaluation_caveat: Filtering by observed effect conditions on a later event and introduces selection bias; report overall choices and outcome-stratified results separately and do not describe the conditional subset as deployment performance.
